description: Advisories broken down by severity rather than counted, with identifiers and dates. Requires a key; see https://sighttrue.com/pricing.

name.description: Package name as the registry spells it.

name: advisory_severity

description: Read a whole manifest and return every reading on record for it, ordered by how much a reviewer would want to know. One call instead of one per dependency. Requires a key; see https://sighttrue.com/pricing.
name: audit_manifest

description: For a container base image: its size, when it was last rebuilt, and whether the OS underneath it is still supported. Requires a key; see https://sighttrue.com/pricing.
name: base_image_check

description: Call this before adding a dependency. Returns only the facts a reviewer would be annoyed to discover afterwards: whether the publisher has withdrawn the package, whether it runs scripts on the installing machine, whether its repository is archived, how many advisories are on record, whether the licence is source-available, and how long since it was actually published. Each fact carries the address of the body that published it. It does not say whether to install; it says what is on record.

name.description: Package name as the registry spells it.

name: check_before_install

description: Check whether a runtime, database or framework release is still receiving security fixes, and what to move to. Covers about two dozen products read daily from endoflife.date.

cycle.description: Release line, e.g. 3.9 or 20. Omit for every cycle.

product.description: Product as endoflife.date spells it, e.g. python, nodejs, postgresql.

name: check_eol

description: Read the current standing of one open-source package: downloads with the window they cover, OpenSSF scorecard, advisory count, licence, whether the repository is archived, and when it was last pushed to.

name.description: Package name as the registry spells it.

name: check_package

description: Recorded incidents for a hosting or API provider over a window, kept after the provider’s own status page dropped them.

provider.description: Provider slug, e.g. cloudflare, openai, github. Omit for every provider.

name: check_provider

description: Read a whole dependency list at once and report what is archived, what carries advisories, what has a source-available licence, and what has not been pushed to in a year. Use when reviewing a package.json, requirements.txt, Cargo.toml, composer.json or Gemfile.
name: check_stack

description: Hold two watched repositories against each other across downloads, OpenSSF scorecard, advisories, forks, stars and findings on record. Compares only; it does not pick a winner.
name: compare_repositories

description: What changed for a set of packages since a given date, read from the daily archive. Requires a key; see https://sighttrue.com/pricing.
name: diff_since

description: Whether the domains a package points at — homepage, funding, documentation — still resolve to a registered owner. Requires a key; see https://sighttrue.com/pricing.

name.description: Package name as the registry spells it.

name: domain_risk

description: Given a finding id, return what was measured, when, by whom, and the address it can be checked at. For an agent quoting a figure into a review. Requires a key; see https://sighttrue.com/pricing.
name: explain_finding

description: Find language models by price and context window, from a catalogue read daily across sixty providers. Use this before choosing a model: prices move without announcement and training data is out of date on the day it ships.

maxPrice.description: Maximum USD per million prompt tokens.

name: find_model

description: Packages that ask for funding, beside how heavily they are installed and how many people write them. Requires a key; see https://sighttrue.com/pricing.
name: funding_gap

description: For a technology tag: questions asked against questions answered, over time. Requires a key; see https://sighttrue.com/pricing.
name: help_availability

description: List every reading this server can return, what each one measures, and which require a key. Call this first if unsure which tool answers a question.
name: list_readings

description: Every recorded price for a model, with the date each was read. Requires a key; see https://sighttrue.com/pricing.
name: model_price_history

description: Models that were in the catalogue and no longer are, with the date last seen. Requires a key; see https://sighttrue.com/pricing.
name: model_withdrawn

description: How the published artefact size has moved over time. Returns the readings taken, not a verdict. Requires a key; see https://sighttrue.com/pricing.

name.description: Package name as the registry spells it.

name: package_weight_history

description: A provider’s recorded incidents, grouped by the component that failed, over the whole archive rather than the window its status page shows. Requires a key; see https://sighttrue.com/pricing.

description: When a provider last changed its terms or pricing page, from a stored fingerprint of the page. Requires a key; see https://sighttrue.com/pricing.
name: provider_terms_changed

description: How long a provider takes to acknowledge an incident: the interval between an incident starting and its first public update. Requires a key; see https://sighttrue.com/pricing.

name: runtime_deadlines

name: search_repositories

description: Days between an advisory being published and a release appearing that postdates it, per package and as a distribution. Requires a key; see https://sighttrue.com/pricing.

name.description: Package name as the registry spells it.

name: time_to_fix

description: Whether a name is one edit away from a more widely installed package. States that both names exist; which one was meant is the caller’s call. Requires a key; see https://sighttrue.com/pricing.

name.description: Package name as the registry spells it.

name: typosquat_check

name: watch_add
